items.title: Cancel appointment if unable to attend (at least 2 working days in advance)
items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: Appointment is Monday 14.12.2026. 'Mindestens zwei Werktage vorher' requires cancellation to reach the practice at least two working days before the appointment. Counting backward from the appointment day using the legal definition of Werktag (Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays, none of which fall in this window): Sunday 13.12. is not a Werktag; Saturday 12.12. counts as the 1st working day before; Friday 11.12. counts as the 2nd working day before. Therefore the latest day the cancellation should reach the practice is Friday, 11.12.2026. This assumes the practice treats Saturday as a Werktag for this purpose; if the practice's own business days are only Mon-Fri, the deadline would instead be Thursday 10.12.2026 (flagged as a warning).

warnings: The cancellation deadline ('mindestens zwei Werktage vorher') is ambiguous: if the practice counts only Monday-Friday as working days (rather than the legal Mon-Sat definition of Werktag), the latest day to cancel would be Thursday, 2026-12-10, instead of Friday, 2026-12-11 as computed.
This is a routine appointment reminder with no payment demand, deadline with legal consequence, or remedy instructions; no signs of phishing or scam were found.
